note.question: How do exponentially smoothed life-cycle forecasts shape bayesian ensembles?
note.overview: This paper studies the problem of forecasting an entire demand distribution for a new product before and after its launch. Firms need accurate distributional forecasts of demand to make operational decisions about capacity, inventory, and marketing expenditures. We introduce a unified, robust, and interpretable approach to producing these preand postlaunch distributional forecasts.
